editor.description: Facts about text files that several tools must agree on. Ropes writes the root editor settings file from this table.

charset.description: The character set of text files.

final_newline.description: Whether a file ends with a newline.

indent_size.description: How many columns one level of indent takes.

indent_style.description: Whether indents are spaces or tabs.

line_width.description: The column a line should not run past.

trim_trailing_whitespace.description: Whether whitespace at the end of a line is removed.

check.description: Check the stated editor settings on selected files without another formatter. Off unless true.

overrides.description: Facts for some files. A later entry wins over an earlier.

isolated.description: Whether packages see only their declared dependencies.

links.description: Whether local Markdown links and heading fragments are checked. Off unless set to true; independent of style checking.

paths.description: Root-relative globs. The settings beside them apply to matching files.

tools.description: One table for each tool, in the tool's own settings. Ropes copies it into the config it generates for that tool.
